scientific_integrity: A rigorous backward-equation and monotonic-ratio classification, with finite independent numerical tests. Only the stated two-interval, constant-hazard, telegraph-motion model is covered; exact prior equivalence outside inspected material remains a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two disjoint finite reactive intervals and constant local capture rates.
Uniform tumbling, no external drift, no additional diffusion; central unbiased release for the reversal classification.
Does not claim mean capture times, universality under different environmental dynamics, or independent validation.
title: A unique speed-induced trapping-side reversal for two finite reactive regions
